content.text:
=== database.yml ===
default: &default
  adapter: postgresql
  encoding: unicode
  host: localhost
  pool: 5
  username:
  password:

development: &development
  <<: *default
  database: consul_development

# The staging, preproduction and production dbs are only needed
# for running rake assets:precompile locally before deploying
staging:
  <<: *development

preproduction:
  <<: *development

production:
  <<: *default
  database: consul_production

test:
  <<: *default
  database: consul_test
=== secret_emails.yml ===
admin@consul.dev
=== secrets.yml (production block) ===
production:
  secret_key_base: "046e75d3ce6d0d7f8185a455cb8457ed7a72fc692a85a2932c838375c7eeb03af72c1d423d0f4638fa44be76aae7680ab4e9efaa60f55b637d8c36221f89ae6d"
  # sentry_key: ""
  # youtube_api_key: ""
  server_name: "localhost"
  # time_zone: ""
  # mailer_delivery_method: :smtp
  # smtp_settings:
  #   :address: "smtp.example.com"
  #   :port: 25
  #   :domain: "your_domain.com"
  #   :user_name: "<username>"
  #   :password: "<password>"
  #   :authentication: "plain"
  #   :enable_starttls_auto: true
  force_ssl: true
  delay_jobs: true
  http_basic_username: ""
  http_basic_password: ""
  authentication_logs: false
  devise_lockable: false
  managers_url: ""
  managers_application_key: ""
  multitenancy: false
  security:
    last_sign_in: false

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== database.yml ==="; cat config/database.yml; echo "=== secret_emails.yml ==="; cat config/secret_emails.yml; echo "=== secrets.yml (production block) ==="; grep -A 25 "production:" config/secrets.yml | head -40
